role: District Representative · Taguig City-Pateros, Lone District
summary: Taguig-Pateros representative with 44 principal-authored bills. Authored a P200 daily wage increase, a labor commission, taxpayer Magna Carta, travel-tax abolition, gender-equality and spousal-support bills, early voting and FOI; also an online gambling ban. Co-authored tertiary subsidy and cooperative code bills.
caveat: Gender and family bills form one issue; the gambling ban was not scored as a rubric topic. Bill-based evidence only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored P200 wage increase and labor commission (-3); tax bills net slightly right (travel tax +2, taxpayer charter +1, menstrual-product VAT exemption -1); co-authored tertiary subsidy (-2).
